name: MKT_CM_STG_ALLOCS
description: This table stores the combination of a segment and a treatment for a specific marketing campaign stage.

columns.name: ALLOC_ID
columns.description: Primary Key Column

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STAGE_ID
columns.description: Stage Id. FK to MKT_CM_STAGES table.

columns.name: CALL_LST_ID
columns.description: Call List Id. FK to MKT_CALL_LST table.

columns.name: TREATMENT_ID
columns.description: Treatment Id. FK to MKT_TM_TREATMENTS table.

columns.name: ALLOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Alloc Number - Alternate key of this table

columns.name: ALLOCATED_CNT
columns.description: Allocated Count

columns.name: ALLOCATED_PCT
columns.description: Allocated Percentage

columns.name: CTRL_GRP_PCT
columns.description: Control Group Percentage

columns.name: PCT_ALLOC_FLG
columns.description: Percentage Allocation Flag

columns.name: EXECUTE_FLG
columns.description: Execute Flag

columns.name: DESC_TXT
columns.description: Description Text

columns.name: SRC_CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Source Campaign Id

columns.name: SRC_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Source Stage Id

columns.name: RESP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Response Type Code

columns.name: RESP_VALUE_CODE
columns.description: Response Value Code

columns.name: LEAD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lead Status Code. Captures the lead status code of  lead header.

columns.name: LEAD_QUALITY_CODE
columns.description: Lead Quality Code. Captures the lead quality code of lead header.

columns.name: LEAD_RANK
columns.description: Lead Rank . Captures the lead rank code of lead header.

columns.name: SCORE_NUM
columns.description: Score Number

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source code of a marketing activity

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
